usage: The top 25 available players per position by rostered percentage, with acquisition cost, bye week, injury badge and upcoming opponents already attached. This is a trimmed view of available_players.json for when a report needs candidates rather than the whole ~850-player pool. Availability still comes from the same snapshot, and player_index.json remains the authority on ownership. acquisition is FREE AGENT ($0, instant) or WAIVERS (needs a FAAB bid, processing at waiver_process_ct). recent_form_rank and recent_form_avg are this player's standing in recent_form_rankings.json, attached here so a report does not have to cross-reference. When those are absent, recent_form_note says why: either outside the ranked top N for the position, or fewer than three confirmed appearances. Players ESPN expects back only next season are excluded from the rankings entirely, so they carry the fewer-than-three note. projected_points is ESPN's projection for projection_scoring_period_id, which is the current week, and is the only forward-looking number here: recent_form_rank looks backwards at three completed games. A projection of 0.0 is usually real rather than missing - the player's NFL team is on bye that week, or he has no NFL team, or ESPN does not expect him to play - so check the upcoming block for a bye before reading 0.0 as poor form. An absent projected_points means ESPN published no projection for him at all, which is common deep in the pool; treat that as unknown, not as zero.
